Michael — thanks for the clear ask. High level answers up front, then details and next steps below.

Summary:
- Proration: If the MPO activation date falls mid-billing-cycle for a monthly invoice, we prorate the first month to the activation date. For annual commitments purchased via Marketplace we prorate the remainder of the first 12-month period only if start date differs from the agreed contract start; subsequent renewals follow the yearly rhythm unless you opt into calendarized billing.
- Quote hold window for activation: Standard is 5 business days from quote issuance for Marketplace activation at the quoted rate. For larger deals (> $250k ARR) we can extend to 10 business days with a conditional finance hold (see exception below).
- CFO/PO review: We routinely allow a short buyer review window prior to activation; we recommend 3 business days for routine deals and up to 7 business days for deals requiring additional legal/finance review — please flag if you need the extended window.

Details / rationale:
- Marketplace activation often requires coordination with AWS (DocuSign + PO submission + seller acceptance). Typical completion: 3-5 business days once PO + DocuSign are received and the MPO is submitted. If you need us to delay activation pending CFO signature, we can place a temporary hold but the quoted pricing will be time-limited per the hold window above.
- Proration examples are in the attached MPO proration chart (first tab: monthly start; second tab: annual start & calendarization options).

Exceptions & escalations:
- For deals requiring a longer signoff window (e.g., > $250k, multi-account MPO, intercompany billing), internal approval from Redwood Finance is required to extend the quote hold beyond 10 business days. In those cases we route to Vanessa and Vivek for expedited approval.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm which signoff window you need (3 / 5 / 7 / 10 business days).
2) Confirm desired activation start date and whether you want the subscription to align with your fiscal quarter (calendarized billing).
3) If you want hold > 10 business days, let us know and we will initiate an internal approval path (requires Finance signoff).

I'm attaching the proration chart for quick reference. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk through invoice examples.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
